candidates.title: Daily sales by product (till system)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of daily units and revenue per product code. Catalog: grain daily, temporal coverage from 2022-01-01 (end null), daily refresh, last refreshed 2026-10-14, ~310,000 rows, no PII flagged.
candidates.found_via: search 'daily sales by product ice cream gelato POS'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink till_migration_2024
suspected_issues: Wiki till_migration_2024 (last edited 2024-03-12): till replaced 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10; no sales recorded and no rows for those days. Treat as missing, not zero.
Wiki product_codes_2024 (last edited 2024-04-02): codes changed from 2024-04-01; codes ending in 'L' replaced; no mapping table exists.
Catalog has no opening/closed flag; closed days may appear only as missing rows.
Units and revenue both present; catalog does not say which is the sales measure.
Recent window ends 2026-03-31; completeness at as-of date not verified.

candidates.title: Product list (current codes)
candidates.why_relevant: Only product master in catalog; lists current codes, names and categories. Could support name-based matching for N2 but holds no pre-2024 codes.
candidates.found_via: search 'product code mapping 2024 change legacy SKU crosswalk'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink product_codes_2024
suspected_issues: Wiki product_codes_2024: lists only current codes; old codes absent.
Wiki product_codes_2024: names are not unique, so name matching may be ambiguous.

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, events)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source for shop opening days and local event names per day. Catalog: daily grain, coverage from 2022-01-01, weekly refresh, last refreshed 2026-10-10, ~1,500 rows.
candidates.found_via: search 'shop opening closure calendar local events'; get_catalog_entry
suspected_issues: No wiki page links to this entry (wiki_backlinks empty), so no documented opening log or rule was found.
Row count ~1,500 may not cover all days in both windows; not verified.

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Register API for daily max temperature via reanalysis for chosen coordinates in northern Italy; covers the needed windows if the window reaches 2026-03-31.
suspected_issues: Register default coordinates (45.44, 10.99) are not a recorded shop location; a city choice must be justified and logged in decisions.md.
Reanalysis lag and revision policy near the as-of date not yet checked.
Register default query is hourly with UTC timezone; daily aggregation must match the local sales day boundary.

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Register API for public holidays by year and country; country IT needed for 2023 to 2026.
suspected_issues: Register does not state whether a nationwide flag is returned; to be checked on profiling.
Regional or local feast days may not be included; these belong to N5.
